NOTIFICATION FOR INTERVIEW
8th October 2026
With reference to the recruitment notification dated 10/Sept/2026 for the engagement of
teaching and non-teaching staffs for academic session 2026-2027 of EMRS-Liyai Khunou. It is
hereby notified to all eligible candidates who have submitted application forms at SDO
Paomata Office, DC complex, Senapati that the interview will be held as per the schedule
below:
VENUE: DRDA Conference Hall, Old DC Office, Senapati.
13th October2026 (Tuesday): English, Science, Hindi, Fine arts and Accountant
14th October 2026 (Wednesday):Staff nurse, Mathematics, PET and Social science.
15th October 2026 (Thursday) warden male & female, JSA, Chowkidar, cook, Mess helper,
Electrician cum plumber and sweeper.
Instructions:
1. Candidates must bring all the original certificates and experience certificate and
identity proof at the time of interview.
2. Final eligibility and remuneration will be as per the latest NESTS guidelines and
approval of the competent authority/DLMC.
3. The details of the date and timing of interview for particular post / subjects are given
in senapati.nic.in or in the notice board of DC Office & SDO Office Senapati.
Sd/-
Dr. Ilungding Rame
I/C Principal EMRS-Liyai Khunou

1. The Deputy commissioner/Chairman, EMRS Senapati
